instruction.text: Orla went to the zoo and made a pictogram showing the number of mammals and reptiles she saw. Answer the questions using the pictogram.

atoms.a: How many more mammals did Orla see than reptiles?
How many animals did Orla see altogether?

instruction.text: The next day Orla went to the farmers’ market, where she counted the number of vegetables and pieces of fruit. Answer the questions using the pictogram.

atoms.a: How many pieces of fruit did Orla see?
Did Orla see more vegetables or pieces of fruit?
How many more vegetables did Orla see than pieces of fruit?
How many pieces of fruit and vegetables did Orla see altogether?
